title: Fix the Array Sum Bounds
description: The program should sum all elements of an array.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 30, the sum of 5, 10, and 15.
actualProblem: The loop starts at index 1 (skipping numbers[0], the value 5) and runs through i = numbers.length (3), which is out of bounds for a 3-element array, throwing an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
explanation: Array iteration should start at index 0 and use < numbers.length as the bound, covering every valid index exactly once without going out of range.
